title: Natural Resource Partners L.P. Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results and Declares Third Quarter 2025 Distribution of $0.75 per Common Unit
summary: HOUSTON, Nov. 04, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Natural Resource Partners L.P. (NYSE:NRP) today reported third quarter 2025 results as follows: For the Three Months Ended Last Twelve Months Ended (In thousands) (Unaudited) September 30, 2025 Net income $ 30,905 $ 148,141 Operating cash flow 41,095 187,318 Free cash flow (1) 41,823 190,146 (1) See "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" and reconciliation tables at the end of this release.
